text: A Song of Ascents. I will lift up{H5375} mine eyes{H5869} unto the mountains:{H2022} From whence{H370} shall my help{H5828} come?{H935}
My help{H5828} [cometh] from Jehovah,{H3068} Who made{H6213} heaven{H8064} and earth.{H776}
He will not suffer{H5414} thy foot{H7272} to be moved:{H4132} He that keepeth{H8104} thee will not slumber.{H5123}
Behold, he that keepeth{H8104} Israel{H3478} Will neither slumber{H5123} nor sleep.{H3462}
Jehovah{H3068} is thy keeper:{H8104} Jehovah{H3068} is thy shade{H6738} upon thy right{H3225} hand.{H3027}
The sun{H8121} shall not smite{H5221} thee by day,{H3119} Nor the moon{H3394} by night.{H3915}
Jehovah{H3068} will keep{H8104} thee from all evil;{H7451} He will keep{H8104} thy soul.{H5315}
Jehovah{H3068} will keep{H8104} thy going out{H3318} and thy coming in{H935} From this time forth and for{H5704} evermore.{H5769}
